meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会安排 3 名漏洞猎手并行找候选漏洞、2 名 PoC 工程师做最小化验证,再交叉复核,最后给出 PASS/BLOCK 结论、漏洞详情、修复方法和回归测试建议。
howto.when: 当你说出 “security-research”“vulnerability audit”“security review” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库的代码安全。
say.note: 启动 3 名猎手和 2 名 PoC 工程师并行审计。

say.text: 对这次 PR 的变更做漏洞审计,只报告可复现的问题。
say.note: 只保留有攻击路径且可验证的结论。

say.text: 审查当前分支对 main 的 diff,验证威胁模型。
say.note: 没有指定目标时,审计会以当前分支与上游的 diff 为范围。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude runs a 5-person team: 3 hunters find candidate flaws, 2 PoC engineers verify with minimal PoCs, cross-check, then output verdict, findings, fixes, and regression checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “security-research”, “vulnerability audit”, “security review”, or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Audit the current repository with security-research.
say_en.note: Starts 3 hunters and 2 PoC engineers in parallel.

say_en.text: Run a vulnerability audit on this PR; only report reproducible issues.
say_en.note: Keeps only findings with an attack path and a working proof.

say_en.text: Review the diff against main and validate the threat model.
say_en.note: No target? It diffs current branch against upstream.
